title: Values Card Sort deck contract
description: Shape of a versioned deck file (data/deck.v*.json). SPEC §4: a deck file is immutable once signed off; a deck change is a new versioned file plus a ratified spec delta.

deckVersion.description: Semantic version of the deck contents, recorded on every session.

instrument.description: Provenance of the paper instrument. Public domain, attributed (SPEC §2).

verification.description: Card-by-card verification status against the source PDFs. The one field the maintainer edits, at C1 sign-off — which is why the fidelity test also pins a card-payload hash that survives this edit.

cardCount.description: Redundant with cards.length on purpose: the fidelity test asserts they agree, so a truncated file cannot pass silently.

id.description: 1-based position in the printed instrument. Contiguous across the deck.

name.description: The value name as printed, uppercase. Apostrophes (GOD'S WILL), hyphens (NON-CONFORMITY), and spaces (INNER PEACE) occur in the deck.

descriptor.description: The italic gloss beneath the name, e.g. "to be accepted as I am".
